import json, urllib.request, urllib.error; BASE='http://127.0.0.1:8080'; CREATOR='Bearer lifestream-local-dev-token'; OUTSIDER='Bearer lifestream-local-collaborator-token'; UPLOAD='up-draft-ep'; FUTURE='2026-08-19T18:00:00Z';

def req(path, method='GET', token=None, body=None):
    headers={}
    if token: headers['Authorization']=token
    data=None
    if body is not None:
        data=json.dumps(body).encode(); headers['Content-Type']='application/json'
    request=urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as resp:
            raw=resp.read().decode(); return resp.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raw=exc.read().decode(); return exc.code, json.loads(raw) if raw else None

scheduled=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/uploads/{UPLOAD}/lifecycle','PATCH',CREATOR,{'visibility':'public','releaseAt':FUTURE})
assert scheduled[0] == 200 and scheduled[1]['status'] == 'scheduled' and scheduled[1]['visibility'] == 'public', scheduled
outsider=req(f'/api/v1/catalog/content/{UPLOAD}','GET',OUTSIDER)
assert outsider[0] == 404, outsider
unpublished=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/uploads/{UPLOAD}/unpublish','POST',CREATOR)
assert unpublished[0] == 200 and unpublished[1]['status'] == 'draft' and unpublished[1]['visibility'] == 'private', unpublished
catalog_after_unpublish=req(f'/api/v1/catalog/content/{UPLOAD}')
assert catalog_after_unpublish[0] == 404, catalog_after_unpublish
taken=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/uploads/{UPLOAD}/takedown','POST',CREATOR)
assert taken[0] == 200 and taken[1]['status'] == 'taken_down' and taken[1]['visibility'] == 'private', taken
blocked_patch=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/uploads/{UPLOAD}/lifecycle','PATCH',CREATOR,{'visibility':'public','releaseAt':'2026-08-17T00:00:00Z'})
assert blocked_patch[0] == 400, blocked_patch
creator_view=req(f'/api/v1/creator/me/uploads/{UPLOAD}','PATCH',CREATOR,{'title':'Halcyon Drift — S1 · E3 · (untitled draft)'})
assert creator_view[0] == 200 and creator_view[1]['status'] == 'taken_down', creator_view
